fields.Name: IT151 - Video Studio Production
fields.Description: Deterministic end-to-end Video Studio production pipeline checks (VSP1-VSP5) using ordered TestLLM scripts, FakeRenderDriver, fake video/TTS generators, and an in-memory MJStorage account (zero live LLM or vendor calls): VSP1 runs a Topic Explainer under Draft through Root -> Director -> Art Director -> Storyboard -> Pre-Production -> Motion Engineer -> Render -> Critic -> Delivered and verifies MJ: Files outputs, zero InlineBase64, and one render call; VSP2 runs IT: VS Data Caller -> Video Studio over a runtime copy of the shipped Query Builder -> Video Studio relationship and verifies Video Studio Standard preset resolution, caller DataSnapshot capture, and fileOutputs propagation; VSP3 runs the Produce Video action via ActionEngineServer and verifies output parameters and the persisted Video Production artifact; VSP4 verifies AI-generated clip provenance, carrier prompt run cost, and HumanReviewNotes disclosure; VSP5 verifies both pre-spend guards (NeverInvent subject blocking and Draft generated-video duration cap refusal) before any vendor spend.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: All five checks (VSP1-VSP5) pass with zero live LLM or vendor calls and clean up all created runtime rows on teardown.
